# ai-ui — Full LLM Specification Index

> Lightweight, accessible Astro components for AI reasoning traces, streaming state, and autonomous agent interfaces. 100% native Astro, Vanilla JS, and CSS variables. Zero React, zero Radix, zero Tailwind.
> Homepage: https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui
> GitHub: https://github.com/michaelvereb/ai-ui

## Architectural Overview

ai-ui provides standard building blocks for AI-enabled web applications:
- Scoped pure CSS with custom properties (`--heat`, `--surface`, `--bg`, `--border`, `--radius`, `--font-sans`).
- Strict zero-dependency philosophy: runs directly inside any Astro v4/v5 project with no React runtime or CSS compiler requirements.
- Pre-built for agents: self-contained files that can be copied directly into `src/components/`.

## Component Reference

### 1. Reasoning
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Reasoning.astro`
- Props: `defaultOpen?: boolean`, `title?: string`, `class?: string`
- Usage: `<Reasoning defaultOpen={true} />`

### 2. ThinkingBar
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/ThinkingBar.astro`
- Props: `autoCycle?: boolean`, `isStreaming?: boolean`, `cycleIntervalMs?: number`
- Usage: `<ThinkingBar autoCycle={true} isStreaming={true} />`

### 3. Steps
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Steps.astro`
- Props: `steps: StepItem[]`, `title?: string`
- Usage: `<Steps steps={stepsData} title="Agent Diagnostic Pipeline" />`

### 4. Tool
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Tool.astro`
- Props: `name: string`, `status: string`, `input: Record<string, any>`, `output?: Record<string, any>`
- Usage: `<Tool name="probe_webmcp" status="completed" input={input} output={output} />`

### 5. ChainOfThought
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/ChainOfThought.astro`
- Props: `nodes: Array<{ title: string; detail?: string; status: 'completed' | 'active' | 'pending' }>`
- Usage: `<ChainOfThought nodes={thoughtNodes} />`

### 6. PromptInput
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/PromptInput.astro`
- Props: `placeholder?: string`, `submitLabel?: string`, `selectedModel?: string`
- Usage: `<PromptInput placeholder="Ask anything..." submitLabel="Execute" />`

### 7. ModelSelector
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/ModelSelector.astro`
- Props: `selectedId?: string`
- Usage: `<ModelSelector selectedId="claude-3-5-sonnet" />`

### 8. Suggestions
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Suggestions.astro`
- Props: `suggestions: Array<{ label: string; description?: string }>`
- Usage: `<Suggestions suggestions={suggestionsList} />`

### 9. Questions
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Questions.astro`
- Props: `question: string`, `description?: string`, `options: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>`
- Usage: `<Questions question="Select crawl intensity:" options={options} />`

### 10. FeedbackBar
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/FeedbackBar.astro`
- Usage: `<FeedbackBar />`

### 11. Attachments
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Attachments.astro`
- Props: `files: Array<{ id: string; name: string; size: string; type?: string }>`
- Usage: `<Attachments files={sampleFiles} />`

### 12. Citation
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Citation.astro`
- Props: `index: number`, `title: string`, `url: string`, `domain?: string`
- Usage: `<Citation index={1} title="RFC 8259" url="https://www.rfc-editor.org" />`

### 13. Message
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Message.astro`
- Props: `role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'`, `authorName?: string`, `timestamp?: string`
- Usage: `<Message role="assistant">Task completed.</Message>`

### 14. Thread
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Thread.astro`
- Props: `title?: string`, `subtitle?: string`
- Usage: `<Thread title="Audit Session">...</Thread>`

### 15. Loader
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Loader.astro`
- Props: `variant: 'spinner' | 'dots' | 'pulse' | 'progress'`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, `progress?: number`
- Usage: `<Loader variant="spinner" size="md" />`

### 16. TextShimmer
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/TextShimmer.astro`
- Props: `text: string`, `duration?: string`
- Usage: `<TextShimmer text="Reasoning about edges..." duration="3s" />`

### 17. Image
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Image.astro`
- Props: `src: string`, `alt: string`, `caption?: string`, `aspectRatio?: string`
- Usage: `<Image src="..." alt="..." caption="..." />`

### 18. Toaster
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/Toaster.astro`
- Usage: `<Toaster />` (triggered globally via `window.aiToast('Notification text')`)

### 19. ThemeCustomizer
- Location: `src/components/ai-ui/ThemeCustomizer.astro`
- Usage: `<ThemeCustomizer />`

### 20. AnimateText
- Location: `src/components/animations/AnimateText.astro`
- Props: `effect: AnimationEffect`, `text: string`, `autoplay?: boolean`
- Usage: `<AnimateText effect="soft-blur-in" text="..." />`
